overview: White sets up f4, Nf3, Bc4 or Bb5 and a quick kingside attack, avoiding the Open Sicilian theory. Black answers with ...e6, ...d6 or ...g6, then ...Nf6 or ...Nge7 and counterplay on the queenside; ...d5 is also possible. White aims for f5 breaks, a Bc4 on f7 and rapid attack on the king; Black counters with ...Qb6, ...b5 and the c-file. Play is direct and tactical.
